newsitem.title: USA: Soros group has 5.88 pct John H Harland stake.
newsitem.headline: Soros group has 5.88 pct John H Harland stake.

text.p: A group led by international financier George Soros said Thursday it has purchased a 5.88 percent stake in John H.Harland & Co Inc, a Decatur, Ga.,-based check printing company.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it acquired 1,809,900 common shares of the company for investment purposes.
The stake includes 303,300 shares purchased by Quantum Partners L.D.C. between September 6 to 18 at prices ranging from $25.137 to $28.055 a share or about $8.11 million.
Quantum Partners is a Curacao, Netherlands Antilles, investment fund that is advised by the New York-based Soros Fund Management.
